qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.boundedRule: Tier one admits only the exact 14-byte, two-instruction fixture block with qword memory BT through RSI plus displacement, RDI index, and its near JAE. The same bytes at an adjacent RIP decline.
admission.restartability: One replay-safe scalar read completes before CF and the conditional target publish. A failing read returns the original block-entry state.

verification.focusedGate: All three measured memory-BT tests pass.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,458 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Signed indices 0, 63, 64, -1, and -65, both old-bit states, exact CF, and both near-JAE destinations match the interpreter with unchanged memory.
verification.negativeCoverage: The same bytes at an adjacent RIP decline, and an inaccessible target rolls back to the block-entry state.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. Absence of the measured site directly establishes bounded admission; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

interpretation: The measured RDI/RSI memory-BT block is absent from the retained negative-cache sample and the authenticated workload completes. A05.2 remains open because 121,150 of 223,195 full-run tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
